title: Print Uniform Block Spacing
description: Fix inconsistent vertical spacing between chapters, sections, paragraphs, windows, and other block elements in print LaTeX. All inter-block gaps must use exactly one spacing unit (semio@spacing@single).
summary: Unified print block vertical spacing to one unit (0.2em / semio@spacing@single). Introduced semio@block@sep skip register. Windows add spacing after close (not before) to avoid doubling with heading after-skip (section→table). Nested SemioNest paragraphs get semio@block@sep before each chip. Table rows use noalign vskip with block sep skip. Fixed scrartcl section navbar ifnum. Verified paper and zwischenbericht builds.
